  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  ; CONSTRAINT: enforce at most 3 stacks (towers) after any move.
  ; A stack is a tower whose bottom block is on the table.
  ; The current number of stacks is represented by exactly one count object.
  (:types block stack-count - object)
  (:predicates
    (on ?b ?c - block)
    (on-table ?b - block)
    (clear ?b - block)
    (holding ?b - block)
    (arm-empty)
    (count ?c - stack-count)
    ; CONSTRAINT BEGIN
    (started)
    (ok-count ?c - stack-count)
    (pickup-next ?c ?d - stack-count)
    (putdown-next ?c ?d - stack-count)
    ; CONSTRAINT END
  )
  ; CONSTRAINT BEGIN
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - stack-count ?d - stack-count)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (count ?c)
      (pickup-next ?c ?d)
      (or (not (started)) (ok-count ?c))
      (ok-count ?d))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (started)
      (count ?d)
      (not (count ?c))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block ?c - stack-count ?d - stack-count)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (count ?c)
      (putdown-next ?c ?d)
      (or (not (started)) (ok-count ?c))
      (ok-count ?d))
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (started)
      (count ?d)
      (not (count ?c))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b - block ?t - block ?c - stack-count)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?t)
      (count ?c)
      (ok-count ?c))
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?t)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?t))
      (started)))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b - block ?t - block ?c - stack-count)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?t)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (count ?c)
      (ok-count ?c))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?t)
      (not (on ?b ?t))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (started)))
  ; CONSTRAINT END
)",

    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
